bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered around a low E pedal tone. A second electric guitar provides harmonized lead lines and occasional pinch harmonics. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern with rapid sixteenth-note bursts and a dry, high-tuned snare. An overdriven electric bass guitar follows the guitar riff exactly. The arrangement is characterized by frequent stops and starts with sudden silence between phrases. Key of E minor. Tempo is 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff with palm muting, syncopated kick drum]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]

[Main Theme]
[full band enters, overdriven bass guitar, double-kick drum patterns]
[harmonized guitar lead enters]

[Bridge]
[staccato guitar chugging, rapid double-bass drum fills]
[sudden silence between musical phrases]

drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A dusty, vinyl-crackling drum break features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly swung snare. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repeating four-bar progression of jazz-influenced seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect. A deep, rounded electric bass follows the root notes of the piano with a laid-back, behind-the-beat feel. A subtle, high-pitched sine wave synth melody enters periodically with heavy portamento. The track maintains a steady 85 BPM in the key of C minor. High-frequency hiss and occasional vinyl pops are layered throughout the mix. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the Rhodes and the drum loop.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss, muffled drum break enters]

[Main Theme]
[Rhodes electric piano playing jazz chords, electric bass enters]

[Bridge]
[sine wave synth with portamento melody, drums continue with swung snare]

[Outro]
[bass and synth fade out, Rhodes piano and vinyl crackle remain until silence]

vocals.tags: Synthwave with a heavy emphasis on retro-futuristic textures. A prominent analog-style synthesizer plays a syncopated, rhythmic lead line using a sawtooth waveform with a short decay and moderate resonance. A deep, compressed sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the lead melody. The percussion consists of a gated reverb snare and a punchy, mid-heavy kick drum. A shimmering, high-frequency synth pad provides sustained harmonic backing in the background. The track is in the key of G minor at 105 BPM.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[syncopated sawtooth synth lead, punchy kick drum]
[gated reverb snare enters]

[Main Theme]
[sub-bass synth enters, locking with kick]
[high-frequency synth pad swells in background]
[staccato synth melody continues]
